name: Welcome to Greenhaven
description: Every new arrival should meet the mayor.

steps.text: Talk to Mayor Lina by the fountain

name: A Horse of Your Own
description: Walking everywhere is slow. Hana has something for you.

steps.text: Talk to Stablemaster Hana on the east side of the plaza
Press Z to ride your pony

name: A Patch of Your Own
description: Your homestead is west along the Sunfield lane, through the south gate.

steps.text: Go to your Homestead (south gate, then west along the lane)
Till, plant, water and harvest a Carrot

name: The Farmer's Friend
description: Rowan sells seeds and buys crops at the Farm Supply in Greenhaven.

steps.text: Talk to Farmer Rowan at the Farm Supply (south-west Greenhaven)

name: Tools of the Trade
description: Miner Bram sells pickaxes near the north road.

steps.text: Buy a Worn Pickaxe from Miner Bram (north Greenhaven)
Mine 5 Copper Ore (Sunfield's north meadow or the mine)

name: Fire and Metal
description: The furnace stands east of the Blacksmith.

steps.text: Smelt a Copper Bar at the furnace (east of the Blacksmith)

name: Slime Trouble
description: Slimes are eating Sunfield's crops. Press F to attack.

steps.text: Defeat 5 Green Slimes in Sunfield Plains (F to attack)

name: Gone Fishing
description: Fisher Olan stands by the pond in south-east Greenhaven.

steps.text: Buy a Bamboo Rod from Fisher Olan (pond, south-east Greenhaven)
Catch any fish (face water, E to cast, E on the bite, hold Space)

name: Down Below
description: Irondeep Mine is north of Greenhaven. Gus runs a lift every five floors.

steps.text: Reach floor 5 of Irondeep Mine (north road)

name: Whisperwood Warning
description: Wolves are prowling Whisperwood Forest (Lv 10+). Get strong first.
